description: This script sets up tests for a git HTTP backend server without a live server, focusing on handling different PATH_INFO inputs, HTTP methods, and ensuring security checks against problematic paths. It defines functions to simulate GET and POST requests and validates responses using test assertions.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Executes the git http-backend with given query string and path, capturing output for validation.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP GET request to the backend and verifies the response status.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP POST request with content type and verifies the response status.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Tests whether a given PATH_INFO is correctly identified as aliased or not, including error message validation.
